info.name: Google — Retro Desktop 1998
info.description: A nostalgic desktop-inspired Google theme: warm ivory paper, teal accents, navy links, monospace typography and beveled controls. Includes keyboard-focus styles and responsive search boxes.
info.additionalInfo: v1.0 — Original CSS, no remote images or fonts. Targets google.com and google.co.th. Designed for Google homepage and search results. Live Google rendering still needs testing in Stylish before release.
